record.name: DealCloud
record.one_liner: DealCloud is a CRM, deal management, and business development platform for financial services and professional firms.
record.access_note: DealCloud is an enterprise product; API credentials and site access are provisioned by your firm or through sales.
record.api_note: The REST API covers user management, schema, data records, backups, publications, and relationship intelligence.
record.blocker_note: Access requires an enterprise customer contract and administrator provisioning, with no self-serve developer signup.

evidence.quote: Authentication – Provides tokens for use with all other APIs.
Once user permissions are set, click the User icon at the top-right of your DealCloud screen and select Profile.
This site provides a comprehensive overview of our REST APIs, their capabilities, and available endpoints.
DealCloud provides a default MCP Server out-of-the-box without any configuration required.

flags_before.detail: access is backed only by non-vendor pages
